instagram:
The Mute Swan (Knölsvan) is a large white swan with an orange and black bill and a black knob at its base.

Identify birds by sound with the free Birdy app. Link in bio.

Photo: Charles J. Sharp, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons, cropped · Sound: Joost van Bruggen, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons, trimmed and edited
